title: Food intolerances
metaDescription: Food intolerances and supplement matching with Touch for Health muscle testing — Patricia Smith at Equilibrium in Takaka, Golden Bay, NZ.

blocks.html: Many clients come to Equilibrium in Takaka unsure which foods or supplements suit them — cupboards full of products that might or might not help, or a body that reacts in ways that are hard to pin down.

blocks.text: How Patricia works with food intolerances

blocks.html: Using Touch for Health muscle testing, Patricia can ask the body about food intolerances, nutrient needs, and whether a supplement is a good match — and at what dose. The aim is to take the guesswork out of eating and supplementing, so you are not cycling from practitioner to practitioner without a clear plan.

This is personalised work at Golden Bay Organics or online: not a generic elimination diet handout. Clients have described clearer digestion, better sleep after adjusting a problematic supplement, and less confusion about what to eat day to day.

items: A conversation about your history, current diet, and what you have already tried
Gentle, non-invasive muscle testing related to foods, nutrients, and supplements
Practical next steps you can follow at home — including recipes when helpful
Follow-up sessions when you want support while changes settle in

blocks.html: Patricia Smith is a Nutritionist (B.Sc.) and registered Touch for Health Kinesiology practitioner serving Takaka and Golden Bay, New Zealand.
